description: This file defines configuration and utility functions for managing opt-in features within a software project, including feature metadata, display logic, and scope-based filtering.

methods.name: getOptInFeatureConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration object for a specific feature slug.

methods.name: isOptInFeature
methods.description: Checks if a given slug is in the list of opt-in features, acting as a type guard.

methods.name: shouldDisplayFeatureAt
methods.description: Determines if a feature should be displayed at a specific location based on its displayLocations property.

methods.name: getOptInFeaturesForScope
methods.description: Filters and returns features available for a given scope and optional display location.

methods.name: isFeatureAllowedForScope
methods.description: Checks if a feature is permitted for a specific scope based on its configuration.
